crossRefs.note: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t…
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I…
Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s…
If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

translations.web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
translations.bsb: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
translations.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will ➔ not glory, but in mine infirmities.
translations.asv: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in my weaknesses.
